claim_policy.MAME-conformant: Behavior agrees with the pinned MAME 0.288 source or a deterministic MAME differential run.
claim_policy.online-evidence-backed: Connectivity, population, layout, or component behavior is supported by a public online source.
claim_policy.PCB-cycle-accurate: Not claimable without direct PCB captures, a complete schematic/netlist, or equivalent silicon evidence.
